purpose: Describe taking special trouble to do something.
keywords: Thank you for taking the trouble to come.
He went out of his way to meet me at the station.
You do not need to make a special trip just for that.
restrictions: Can also imply unnecessary trouble when used critically or with a negative.
mistake: It is not simply on purpose; some extra effort or detour is implied.
